stop.prompt: Review the agent's work in this turn. If any verification or test task was part of the workflow (linting, building, test suites, pre-commit hooks, helm lint, npm test, mvn verify, etc.) check whether the agent either: (1) ran the command successfully, or (2) told the user the required tool is missing and provided the exact command to run manually. If a verification step was silently skipped or omitted without handing the command to the user, return a followup_message asking the agent to run it or provide the command. Otherwise, allow completion. Here is the hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Review the agent's work in this turn. Determine if the agent ran an /opsx:apply, /opsx:archive, or /archive-finish command (look for openspec apply/archive operations, task implementations with checkbox updates, or directory moves to openspec/changes/archive/). If it did, check whether the agent committed the changes with 'git commit' before stopping. If the agent completed opsx work but did NOT commit, return a followup_message: 'You completed opsx work but did not commit the changes. Stage and commit all changes now with an appropriate opsx commit message.' If no opsx work was done, or a commit was already made, allow completion. Here is the hook input: $ARGUMENTS
